tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Facts about 313 Automations: what it does, address, email, phone, founding year, and where its prices and pages are published.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Starting prices for every published 313 Automations service, in Pakistani rupees, as Markdown. Final prices are quoted after the project is scoped.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Every page on 313automations.com, grouped by topic, with its address and a one-line summary.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The text of one page of 313automations.com as Markdown.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find the pages of 313automations.com that best match some words, with each page address and a short extract.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
